tools.name: ai_market
tools.description: Read-only snapshot of the $AI/HYPE AiCurve: price, sold, retired, circulating, reserve, supply, sell fee (read live from chain), contracts, chain id, rpc, and the fee/no-guarantee disclosure. Call it first to check the curve state; it takes no amount. For a price on a specific amount use ai_quote_bu

tools.name: ai_quote_buy
tools.description: Quote how much $AI a given amount of HYPE buys right now, before slippage. Use it to preview a buy; it returns no transaction. To get the calldata for that buy, call ai_build_buy_tx with the same hype amount.

tools.name: ai_quote_sell
tools.description: Quote how much HYPE a given amount of $AI returns right now, net of the on-chain sell fee. Use it to preview a sell; it returns no transaction. To get the calldata, call ai_build_sell_tx with the same ai amount.

tools.name: ai_build_buy_tx
tools.description: Build an unsigned buy transaction against the AiCurve contract. Returns calldata only; the caller signs and sends it. Includes an estimated gas limit when `from` is given. tools.name: ai_build_sell_tx
tools.description: Build the unsigned transaction(s) to sell $AI: an approve first if allowance is insufficient, then the sell. Returns calldata only; the caller signs and sends, in order. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ai_market" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read-only snapshot of the $AI/HYPE AiCurve: price, sold, retired, circulating, reserve, supply, sell fee (read live from chain), contracts, chain id, rpc, and the fee/no-guarantee disclosure. Call it first to check the curve state; it takes no amount. For a price on a specific amount use ai_quote_bu" → after: "Read-only snapshot of the $AI/HYPE AiCurve: price, sold, retired, circulating, reserve, supply, sell fee (read live from chain), contracts, chain id, rpc, and the fee/no-guarantee disclosure. Takes no amount; for a price on a specific amount use ai_quote_buy (the recommended first call) or ai_quote_"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
